parameters.content: This workflow assumes project and milestone mappings are already in the shared state file. It resolves task status by Linear workflow state type, not by raw status name equality, matching the current Python invariant. Keep it on the shortest schedule of the three main workflows.

parameters.jsCode:
const sourceTrigger = $execution.mode === 'manual' ? 'manual' : ($input.first()?.json?.body ? 'notion-trigger' : 'schedule');
return [{ json: { workflowName: 'notion-linear-tasks-sync', sourceTrigger, startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), executionId: String($execution.id || Date.now()) } }];

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: $env.NOTION_AUTOMATION_LOG_DB_ID }, properties: { timestamp: { date: { start: $json.startedAt } }, name: { title: [{ text: { content: `${$json.workflowName} pending` } }] }, details: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: 'Tasks sync started by ' + $json.sourceTrigger } }] }, status: { select: { name: 'pending' } }, workflow: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.workflowName } }] }, 'execution id': { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.executionId } }] }, 'source trigger': { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.sourceTrigger } }] } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { details: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.details || 'Tasks sync finished' } }] }, status: { select: { name: $json.status || 'success' } }, 'failed node': $json.errors?.length ? { rich_text: [{ text: { content: 'Sync Tasks' } }] } : { rich_text: [] } } }) }}
